message.jaymoskingdoms.style.plain: You put your styles aside and fight plain.
message.jaymoskingdoms.style.studied: You study the book until the %s style is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.style.drilled: The drill has sunk in: the %s style is yours.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.title: The %s
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.author: An old hand
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.iron_gate.0: The gate does not chase. Feet square, blade in front, and let them come to you. Every guard you keep costs you little; every blow you give, a little more.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.iron_gate.1: Drill it until you're bored of it, then drill it again. A soldier who tires last is the one left standing.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.long_road.0: Nobody pays you to stand still. Strike, step, strike again before they've turned. You'll take a blow you could have kept; take it and keep moving.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.long_road.1: The road is long and the pay is late. Breathe between fights, because there is always another.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.still_water.0: Water does not strike first. It takes the blow and gives it back. Keep your guard cheap and your patience long.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.still_water.1: A turned blow costs the one who threw it. Let them pay.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.long_measure.0: Stay at the point. The spear's length is the only guard it needs, until it isn't.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.long_measure.1: Thrust, and be gone before they close. If they close, you were too slow.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.deep_root.0: The root does not hurry. Each blow is sure, and the breath comes back before it's missed.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.deep_root.1: Stand. Let them tire on you. Then put them down.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.low_flame.0: Quick hands, low and close. There is nothing behind the knife to hide behind, so don't be where the blow lands.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.low_flame.1: Burn bright and short. Then be somewhere else.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.red_ember.0: Wild and fast, and dear to keep up. The ember burns hottest just before it goes out.
book.jaymoskingdoms.style.red_ember.1: Win quickly, or rest. There is no third way.
